Privacy Policy

All the personal information you provide is kept confidential.
I respect everyone's privacy.

Visits are counted with Murmur, a self-hosted analytics tool that uses no cookies and collects no personal data: no IP addresses, no visitor IDs and no fingerprinting.

It records only anonymous information such as the page visited, the website you came from, your browser and device type, and your country (worked out from your timezone, not your IP address). This data can't be linked to you.

Murmur runs on Cloudflare's network. Like any web host, Cloudflare handles the network connection needed to deliver requests, but Murmur itself never reads or stores your IP address.

Any collected data will not be sold to third parties.
